# interval finishes

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:intervalFinishes`](gmeow-intervalFinishes.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/intervalFinishes>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Allen FINISHES: this interval and the related interval end together, and this one began later. NOT transitive. Inverse of [`gmeow:intervalFinishedBy`](gmeow-intervalFinishedBy.md). (= [time:intervalFinishes](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#intervalFinishes))

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when two intervals share an end instant but the subject began later — a closing sub-span (final sprint, last act) that ends with its enclosing span.

### Avoid when

- Avoid when the intervals also share their start (use [`gmeow:intervalStarts`](gmeow-intervalStarts.md)) or are fully co-extensive (use [`gmeow:intervalCoincidesWith`](gmeow-intervalCoincidesWith.md)); FINISHES is the shared-end-only case and is NOT transitive.

### How to use

- Assert from the shorter, co-finishing interval to the longer one; the inverse [`gmeow:intervalFinishedBy`](gmeow-intervalFinishedBy.md) follows automatically (= [time:intervalFinishes](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#intervalFinishes)).

### Examples

- ex:finalSprint [`gmeow:intervalFinishes`](gmeow-intervalFinishes.md) ex:project.
